usageNotes: This endpoint is used exclusively by Proxmox's internal CT live-migration machinery to establish the migration tunnel on the destination node; it should not be called directly by external tooling or scripts. Requires both VM.Allocate on the target VMID and Sys.Incoming at the root level on the destination node. Returns a socket path, a ticket, and a UPID — the UPID can be polled via the tasks API to track tunnel/migration progress.

examples.summary: Open a migration tunnel for CT 112 on destination node pve2, pre-checking storage 'local-lvm' and bridge 'vmbr0'

tips: The bridges and storages params are pre-flight checks only — Proxmox re-validates the actually-used resources during migration itself.
The returned socket is a Unix socket path on the destination node used for the migration data stream; it is consumed by the source node automatically.
Poll the returned UPID against GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to monitor tunnel and migration state.
Sys.Incoming is a rarely granted privilege; ensure the destination node's API user has it at '/' before invoking migration flows.
